seasons.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
seasons.quote: The best time for sowing seed in nursery is mid August to mid September.

nursery_days.quote: When the seedlings are one month old, transplant them in the field.

days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: The main sprouts are ready for harvest in about 65 days after transplanting.

harvest_span_days.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
harvest_span_days.quote: It takes 70-75 days from transplanting to harvesting.
harvest_span_days.note: Varieties are ready at 65 and 75 days: about 10 days of cutting (side shoots follow 10-12 days later).

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: Package of practices for cultivation of vegetables (2021)
water_need.quote: Subsequent irrigations can be given at an interval of 7-8 days during summer and 10-15 days during winter depending upon soil type and weather.
water_need.note: The page says broccoli needs the same as cauliflower; every 7-15 days is read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.
